description: Returns the grouped options reference (clock, ui, labels, behavior, callbacks, timezone, range, wheel, clearBehavior) with type, default, description and nested fields, extracted from options.d.ts. Deprecated options are left out unless asked for. Pass a group to narrow it.

group.description: Limit to a single option group.

includeDeprecated.description: Also return deprecated options (old names that still work in 4.x and are removed in 5.0).

name: get_options
title: Get grouped options
